mapper.select:
/* saleson.shop.designateddonation.DesignatedDonationMapper.selectDesignatedDonationList 지정기부 목록 조회 */
SELECT T_C.* , C3.LABEL AS PRJ_STATUS_DESC FROM ( SELECT T_A.PRJ_ID , T_A.LOCGOV_NM , CASE WHEN T_A.PRJ_STATUS = '2' THEN CASE WHEN T_B.CNTR_AMT > T_A.TARGET_AMT THEN '9' WHEN IN_DATE = 3 THEN '9' ELSE T_A.PRJ_STATUS END ELSE T_A.PRJ_STATUS END AS PRJ_STATUS , T_A.PRJ_IMAGE , T_A.BSNS_TYPE , T_A.BSNS_TYPE_DESC , T_A.BSNS_SUB_TYPE , T_A.BSNS_SUB_TYPE_DESC , T_A.PRJ_SUBJECT , NVL(T_B.CNTR_CNT, 0) AS CNTR_CNT , T_A.PRJ_ST_DT , T_A.PRJ_ED_DT , T_A.TARGET_AMT , NVL(T_B.CNTR_AMT, 0) AS CNTR_AMT , T_A.DISPLAY_FLAG , T_A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM , CASE WHEN NVL(MAX(T_A.TARGET_AMT), 0) <> 0 THEN FLOOR(NVL(SUM(T_B.CNTR_AMT), 0) * 10000.0 / T_A.TARGET_AMT) / 100 ELSE 0 END AS RATE_AMT , T_A.IN_DATE , T_A.DSGNCNTR_PART_NAME
, NVL(T_B.CNTR_AMT, 0) AS SUM_AMT FROM ( SELECT P.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID AS PRJ_ID , CONCAT(MAX(G.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM), ' ', MAX(G.LOCGOV_NM)) AS LOCGOV_NM , MAX(P.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_STTS_CD) AS PRJ_STATUS , MAX(P.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_RPRS_IMG) AS PRJ_IMAGE , MAX(P.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_SE_CD) AS BSNS_TYPE , MAX(C1.LABEL) AS BSNS_TYPE_DESC , MAX(P.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_SE_DTL_CD) AS BSNS_SUB_TYPE , MAX(C2.LABEL) AS BSNS_SUB_TYPE_DESC , MAX(P.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_TTL) AS PRJ_SUBJECT , MAX(P.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_BGNG_YMD) AS PRJ_ST_DT , MAX(P.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_END_YMD) AS PRJ_ED_DT , MAX(P.GOAL_AMT) AS TARGET_AMT , MAX(P.RLS_YN) AS DISPLAY_FLAG , MAX(P.FRST_REG_DT) AS FRST_REGIST_PNTTM , CASE WHEN DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_END_YMD >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d') THEN CASE WHEN DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_BGNG_YMD <= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ELSE 3 END AS IN_DATE , IFNULL(DPM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_DEPT_NM, '부서 미지정') AS DSGNCNTR_PART_NAME
FROM G_DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_MNG P JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C1 ON C1.CODE_TYPE = 'BUSINESS_TYPE' AND C1.ID = P.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_SE_CD JOIN G_LOCGOV G ON G.LOCGOV_CODE = P.LCLGV_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C2 ON C2.CODE_TYPE = 'BUSINESS_SUB_TYPE' AND C2.ID = P.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_SE_DTL_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN G_DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_DEPT_MNG DPM ON DPM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_DEPT_ID = P.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_DEPT_ID WHERE 1 = 1
AND P.LCLGV_CD = #{locgovCode}
AND P.LCLGV_CD IN (SELECT LOCGOV_CODE FROM G_LOCGOV WHERE UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE = #{upperLocgovCode})
AND P.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_SE_CD = #{bsnsType}
AND ((P.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_BGNG_YMD BETWEEN #{prjStDt} AND #{prjEdDt}) OR (P.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_END_YMD BETWEEN #{prjStDt} AND #{prjEdDt}) OR (#{prjStDt} BETWEEN P.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_BGNG_YMD AND P.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_END_YMD) OR (#{prjEdDt} BETWEEN P.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_BGNG_YMD AND P.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_END_YMD) )
AND (#{prjStDt} BETWEEN P.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_BGNG_YMD AND P.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_END_YMD)
AND (#{prjEdDt} BETWEEN P.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_BGNG_YMD AND P.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_END_YMD)
AND P.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID NOT IN (
#{item}
)
AND DPM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_DEPT_ID = #{dsgncntrPartId}
AND P.RLS_YN = #{displayFlag}
AND P.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_TTL LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
GROUP BY P.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID ) T_A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT C.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID AS PRJ_ID , NVL(SUM(C.CNTR_AMT), 0) AS CNTR_AMT , COUNT(C.*) AS CNTR_CNT FROM G_CNTR C WHERE 1=1 AND C.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID > 0 AND C.CNTR_DE <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE , 'YYYYMMDD') AND C.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND C.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND C.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' GROUP BY C.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID ) T_B ON T_A.PRJ_ID = T_B.PRJ_ID WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY T_A.PRJ_ID ) T_C LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C3 ON T_C.PRJ_STATUS = C3.ID AND C3.CODE_TYPE = 'PRJ_STATUS' WHERE 1=1
AND T_C.PRJ_STATUS = #{prjStatus}
AND T_C.PRJ_STATUS = '2' AND SYS_DATE BETWEEN T_C.PRJ_ST_DT AND T_C.PRJ_ED_DT
AND T_C.PRJ_STATUS IN ('2', '9') AND T_C.DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y'
ORDER BY RANDOM()
ORDER BY PRJ_STATUS
, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM DESC
, CNTR_AMT DESC
, RATE_AMT DESC
, IN_DATE , PRJ_ED_DT
, BSNS_SUB_TYPE
ORDER BY T_C.PRJ_ID DESC

SELECT T_A.PRJ_ID , T_A.PRJ_SUBJECT , T_A.PRJ_CN , T_A.PRJ_ST_DT , T_A.PRJ_ED_DT , T_A.TARGET_AMT , T_A.PRJ_STATUS , T_A.DISPLAY_FLAG , T_A.PRJ_IMAGE , T_A.BSNS_TYPE , T_A.BSNS_SUB_TYPE , T_A.LOCGOV_CODE , T_A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM , T_A.LOCGOV_NM , T_A.CNTR_CNT , T_A.SUM_AMT , T_A.RATE_AMT , T_A.IN_DATE , T_A.LEFT_DAY , CASE WHEN T_A.PRJ_STATUS = '2' THEN CASE WHEN T_A.CNTR_AMT > T_A.TARGET_AMT THEN '9' WHEN IN_DATE = 3 THEN '9' ELSE T_A.PRJ_STATUS END ELSE T_A.PRJ_STATUS END AS PRJ_STATUS , T_A.DSGNCNTR_PART_ID FROM ( SELECT DPM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID AS PRJ_ID , DPM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_TTL AS PRJ_SUBJECT , DPM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_CN AS PRJ_CN , DPM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_BGNG_YMD AS PRJ_ST_DT , DPM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_END_YMD AS PRJ_ED_DT , DPM.GOAL_AMT AS TARGET_AMT , DPM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_STTS_CD AS PRJ_STATUS , DPM.RLS_YN AS DISPLAY_FLAG , DPM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_RPRS_IMG AS PRJ_IMAGE , DPM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_SE_CD AS BSNS_TYPE , DPM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_SE_DTL_CD AS BSNS_SUB_TYPE , DPM.LCLGV_CD AS LOCGOV_CODE , DPM.FRST_REG_DT AS FRST_REGIST_PNTTM , CONCAT(LOC.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM , ' ', LOC.LOCGOV_NM) AS LOCGOV_NM , IFNULL(COUNT(CNTR.CNTR_SN), 0) AS CNTR_CNT , IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(CNTR.CNTR_AMT, 0)), 0) AS CNTR_AMT , IFNULL(SUM(CNTR.CNTR_AMT), 0) AS SUM_AMT , FLOOR((SELECT CAST(SUM(IFNULL(CNTR.CNTR_AMT, 0)) AS NUMERIC(15, 4))) * 10000.0 / DPM.GOAL_AMT) / 100 AS RATE_AMT , CASE WHEN DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_END_YMD >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d') THEN CASE WHEN DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_BGNG_YMD <= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ELSE 3 END AS IN_DATE , DATEDIFF(NOW(), DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_END_YMD) AS LEFT_DAY , DPM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_DEPT_ID AS DSGNCNTR_PART_ID FROM G_DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_MNG DPM LEFT OUTER JOIN G_CNTR CNTR ON CNTR.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID = DPM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID AND CNTR.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND CNTR.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND CNTR.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' , G_LOCGOV LOC WHERE 1=1 AND DPM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID = #{value} AND LOC.LOCGOV_CODE = DPM.LCLGV_CD GROUP BY DPM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID ) T_A

/* saleson.shop.designateddonation.DesignatedDonationMapper.selectImgListByPrjId 지정기부 이미지 조회 byPrjId*/
SELECT DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_IMG_ID AS DSGNCNTR_PRJ_IMAGE_ID ,DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID AS PRJ_ID ,IMG_NM AS IMAGE_NAME ,IMG_SEQ AS "ORDERING" FROM G_DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_IMG_MNG WHERE DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID = #{value} ORDER BY IMG_SEQ ASC

/* getItemImageByImageId 단일 지정기부 이미지 조회 by ImageId*/ SELECT II.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_IMG_ID AS DSGNCNTR_PRJ_IMAGE_ID ,II.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID AS PRJ_ID ,II.IMG_NM AS IMAGE_NAME ,II.IMG_SEQ AS "ORDERING"
FROM G_DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_IMG_MNG II INNER JOIN G_DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_MNG I ON II.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID = I.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID WHERE II.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_IMG_ID = #{value}

/* saleson.shop.designateddonation.DesignatedDonationMapper.selectDesignatedCntrCnt 지정기부 기부 목록 카운트 조회 */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM G_CNTR CNTR , OP_USER U WHERE CNTR.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND CNTR.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND CNTR.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND CNTR.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID = #{prjId} AND U.USER_ID = CNTR.USER_ID

/* saleson.shop.designateddonation.DesignatedDonationMapper.selectDesignatedDonationNoticeImgDescList 지정기부 공지내용 이미지 접근성 설명 조회 */ SELECT DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_NTC_ID AS PRJ_NOTICE_ID , IMG_EXPLN AS IMG_DESC , IMG_SEQ FROM G_DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_NTC_CN_IMG_EXPLN WHERE 1=1 AND DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_NTC_ID = #{value}

/* saleson.shop.designateddonation.DesignatedDonationMapper.selectDesignatedDonationNoticeFileList 지정기부 공지사항 파일 목록 조회 */ SELECT DPN.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_NTC_ID AS PRJ_NOTICE_ID , DPNF.FILE_SEQ , DPNF.ORGNFL_NM AS ORG_FILE_NAME , DPNF.PATH_NM AS PATH_NAME , DPNF.FILE_NM AS FILE_NAME FROM G_DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_NTC_MNG DPN JOIN G_DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_NTC_FILE_MNG DPNF ON DPN.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_NTC_ID = DPNF.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_NTC_ID WHERE DPN.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_NTC_ID = #{prjNoticeId} ORDER BY DPNF.FILE_SEQ DESC

/* saleson.shop.designateddonation.DesignatedDonationMapper.getDesignatedDonationNoticeFileMaxSequence 지정기부 공지사항 최대 순번값 조회 */ SELECT DPN.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_NTC_ID AS DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_NTC_ID , IFNULL(MAX(DPNF.FILE_SEQ), 0) AS FILE_SEQ FROM G_DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_NTC_MNG DPN LEFT OUTER JOIN G_DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_NTC_FILE_MNG DPNF ON DPN.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_NTC_ID = DPNF.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_NTC_ID WHERE DPN.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_NTC_ID = #{prjNoticeId} GROUP BY DPN.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_NTC_ID ORDER BY DPNF.FILE_SEQ DESC

/** saleson.shop.designateddonation.DesignatedDonationMapper.getManagerRequestDetails (관리자 권한 승인관리 상세 조회) */ SELECT A.USER_ID ,A.REQST_SN ,LOGIN_ID AS LOGIN_ID ,A.LOCGOV_CODE ,A.REQST_SE_CODE ,A.PSITN_CODE ,A.PSITN_NM ,A.PSITN_DEPT_NM ,OFCPS_NM AS OFCPS_NM ,CTTPC AS CTTPC ,A.CONFM_STTUS_CODE ,A.REJECT_RESN ,A.FRST_REGISTER_ID ,A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM ,A.LAST_UPDUSR_ID ,A.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM ,USER_NAME AS USER_NAME ,EMAIL AS EMAIL ,PHONE_NUMBER AS PHONE_NUMBER ,BIRTHDAY AS BIRTHDAY ,A.RECEIVE_EMAIL ,A.CONFM_STTUS_NM ,A.REQST_SE_NM ,A.LOCGOV_NM ,A.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM ,A.BANK_NM ,A.UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE ,A.DSGNCNTR_PART_ID , A.MANAGER_LOCGOV_CODE , A.REQ_DSGNCNTR_PART_ID FROM ( SELECT R.USER_ID, R.REQST_SN, R.LOGIN_ID, R.LOCGOV_CODE, R.REQST_SE_CODE, R.PSITN_CODE, R.PSITN_NM, R.PSITN_DEPT_NM, R.OFCPS_NM, R.CTTPC, R.CONFM_STTUS_CODE, R.REJECT_RESN, R.FRST_REGISTER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(R.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'%Y-%m-%d') AS FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, R.LAST_UPDUSR_ID, DATE_FORMAT(R.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM,'%Y-%m-%d') AS LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, U.USER_NAME, U.EMAIL, UD.PHONE_NUMBER, UD.BIRTHDAY, UD.RECEIVE_EMAIL, C1.LABEL AS CONFM_STTUS_NM, C2.LABEL AS REQST_SE_NM, C3.LABEL AS LOCGOV_NM, C4.LABEL AS UPPER_LOCGOV_NM, C5.LABEL AS BANK_NM, CONCAT(SUBSTR(R.LOCGOV_CODE, 1, 2), '000') AS UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE, NVL(DPM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_DEPT_ID, 0) AS DSGNCNTR_PART_ID, M.LOCGOV_CODE AS MANAGER_LOCGOV_CODE , NVL(DPUM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_DEPT_ID, 0) AS REQ_DSGNCNTR_PART_ID FROM G_MNGR_REQST R INNER JOIN OP_USER U ON U.USER_ID = R.USER_ID INNER JOIN OP_USER_DETAIL UD ON UD.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C1 ON C1.CODE_TYPE = 'CFM_STATUS' AND C1.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C1.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C1.ID = R.CONFM_STTUS_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C2 ON C2.CODE_TYPE = 'REQST_SE_CODE' AND C2.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C2.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C2.ID = R.REQST_SE_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C3 ON C3.CODE_TYPE = 'LOCGOV_CODE' AND C3.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C3.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C3.ID = R.LOCGOV_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C4 ON C4.CODE_TYPE = 'WDR' AND C4.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C4.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C4.ID = CONCAT(SUBSTR(R.LOCGOV_CODE, 1, 2), '000') LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C5 ON C5.CODE_TYPE = 'OFF_BANK_LIST' AND C5.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C5.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C5.ID = R.PSITN_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN G_DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_DEPT_MNGR_MPNG DPUM ON U.USER_ID = DPUM.USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_MANAGER M ON U.USER_ID = M.USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN G_DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_DEPT_MNG DPM ON DPUM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_DEPT_ID = DPM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_DEPT_ID AND DPM.USE_YN = 'Y' AND M.LOCGOV_CODE = DPM.LCLGV_CD WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} AND R.REQST_SN = #{reqstSn} ) A

/** saleson.shop.designateddonation.DesignatedDonationMapper.selectDsgncntrPartId (지정기부 부서 조회) */
SELECT IFNULL(DPM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_DEPT_ID, 0) AS DSGNCNTR_PART_ID FROM OP_MANAGER M LEFT JOIN G_DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_DEPT_MNGR_MPNG DPUM ON M.USER_ID = DPUM.USER_ID LEFT JOIN G_DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_DEPT_MNG DPM ON DPM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_DEPT_ID = DPUM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_DEPT_ID AND M.LOCGOV_CODE = DPM.LCLGV_CD AND DPM.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE 1=1 AND M.USER_ID = #{value}

SELECT b.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID AS dsgnDntnBizId, b.GOAL_AMT AS goalAmt, sum(c.CNTR_AMT) AS payAmt FROM G_DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_MNG b JOIN G_CNTR c ON c.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID = b.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID WHERE b.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_STTS_CD = '2' AND c.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND c.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = b.LCLGV_CD AND b.RLS_YN = 'Y' AND c.DELETE_AT = 'N' GROUP BY b.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID HAVING SUM(c.CNTR_AMT) >= b.GOAL_AMT UNION ALL SELECT b.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID AS dsgnDntnBizId, 0 AS goalAmt, 0 AS payAmt FROM G_DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_MNG b WHERE b.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_STTS_CD = '2' AND b.dsgn_dntn_biz_end_ymd < sysdate AND b.RLS_YN = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE G_DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_MNG SET DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_STTS_CD = '9' WHERE DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID = #{dsgnDntnBizId}
